cycle.note: Oklahoma counts CPE by calendar year in a rolling three-year window: 120 hours and 4 ethics over any three years, at least 20 every year. Licenses renew yearly at the end of your birth month.

requirements.label: Three-year total
requirements.note: Any three consecutive calendar years must reach 120 hours (starting with the year you were certified).

requirements.label: Minimum each year
requirements.note: At least 20 hours every calendar year — including the year you're first certified.

requirements.label: Technical (permit holders)
requirements.note: Permit holders: at least 20 technical hours each year (not in the year the permit is first issued).

requirements.label: Nano-learning
requirements.note: Maximum, not a target. Up to 20 nano courses (4 hours) count each year.

requirements.label: Ethics
requirements.note: At least 4 hours of ethics in each rolling three-year period.

practiceOptions.label: I hold a permit to practice

licenseDateHint: Oklahoma licenses renew every year on the last day of your birth month. CPE is tracked by calendar year.
issueDateHint: New registrants need 20 hours by December 31 of the year they're certified; the three-year totals start that year.
limitsNotTracked: CPAs in industry: 72 of the 120 in subjects related to public accounting, plus 8 a year in accounting, tax or assurance.
Compilation permit holders: 4 hours of compilation CPE each year.
Published materials: max 10 hours a year; self-study must be interactive.
recordRetention: Keep CPE records for at least 5 years from the end of the year completed.
toVerify: New registrants: 20 hours by December 31 of the certification year.
